english.note: Use this for someone whose manner is refined, gentle, or well-behaved, rather than simply stating that they have good manners.

exampleSentences.english: They speak in a very polite, refined way.
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 gong2 je5 hou2 si1 man4

english.note: Use this for a person or their manner and appearance when the emphasis is cultured, well-mannered refinement rather than visual grace.

exampleSentences.english: He looks elegant in a suit.
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 zoek3 sai1 zong1 hou2 si1 man4
